properties.description: After reset, public occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue count at every eligible pre/post observation. Acceptance uses pre-edge model occupancy, not DUT flags: full rejects writes and empty rejects reads.
Full is known and asserted exactly when the independent queue contains 16 words, including simultaneous transfers and boundary rejection.
Empty is known and asserted exactly when the independent queue contains zero words, including simultaneous transfers and boundary rejection.

Whenever the independent queue is nonempty, asynchronous output equals its oldest accepted word. Checks FIFO ordering, data integrity, wraparound, simultaneous transfers, rejected operations, and reuse after reset. Empty data is unconstrained.
Following each synchronous reset edge until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is clear, and empty is asserted, including reset of a nonempty queue.
Public occupancy is known and in the range 0 through 16; full and empty exactly match its full and empty boundary values. Unknown occupancy or flags raise an alarm.
